# The Goal — Goldratt

**Rating:** 5/5 · read in August.

## The one idea
Every system has one constraint. Improving anything else is a mirage. Find it, exploit it, subordinate everything to it, then elevate it.

## How I use it
"If I tripled X, what breaks first?" This week the constraint is the Academy application, not outreach. Outreach gets one block a day; the application gets the morning.
